# RepoCode

> RepoCode is a CLI that packs a repository into task-scoped, token-budgeted context for coding agents and LLMs — give it a task and a budget, and it finds the files that matter.

Discovers files, ranks them by structural importance, import centrality, recency, and relevance to a query, then fits the highest-ranked ones into a token budget — compressing lower-ranked files first rather than truncating. Scopes to `--query`, `--diff`, `--branch`, or `--pr` instead of packing a whole repository. Ships as a CLI, an MCP server, and an embeddable core library. No telemetry; nothing leaves the machine unless a network-touching flag (`--llm-provider`, `--query-mode semantic`, `--remote`) is explicitly set.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/README.md): quickstart, CLI reference, configuration, MCP setup, FAQ
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [Architecture](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): pipeline design

## Packages

- [repocode](https://www.npmjs.com/package/repocode): CLI — the primary user-facing entry point
- [@repocode/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@repocode/core): core pipeline library — embed it in your own tools
- [@repocode/mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@repocode/mcp): MCP server — exposes context tools to AI assistants
